description: FastAPI route handlers for CRUD operations on 'Item' objects, including listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting items with permission checks.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router instance configured for '/items' endpoints.

methods.name: read_items
methods.description: Retrieve list of items with optional pagination, filtered by user permissions.

methods.name: read_item
methods.description: Retrieve a single item by ID with permission check.

methods.name: create_item
methods.description: Create a new item with current user as owner.

methods.name: update_item
methods.description: Update an existing item with permission check.

methods.name: delete_item
methods.description: Delete an item with permission check.
